learningObjective: See a sparse user-item matrix split into dense user and item factors, then see why fixing one factor turns each row update into an independent least-squares solve.
mediumRationale: One deterministic matrix SVG can combine factor shapes, sparse observations, and alternating row or column solves. Multiple Mermaid and HTML visuals would fragment one mental model.
